findings.title: The script writes the webhook URL to the wrong env file when run from the repository root
findings.body: `ENV_FILE` is resolved relative to the caller's working directory, not the script's location. Running this script from the repository root—the natural invocation for `scripts/test-gcal-webhooks.sh`—writes `GOOGLE_WEBHOOK_URL` to `../.env`, outside the repository, so the web app will not use the tunnel URL and Google webhook testing will fail. Resolve the path relative to the script or use the project-root `.env` path.

findings.title: Expired cache entries are reported as active cache status
findings.body: This status query groups every cache row for the credential without checking `expiresAt`. Once a cache entry expires, it is no longer served by `getCachedAvailability`, but its `updatedAt` is still returned and the UI presents it as cache status and offers cache deletion. Filter to unexpired rows (or otherwise distinguish expired entries) so the displayed status reflects data that can actually be used.
